steps.title: Define Modern Calculator Enhancements
steps.description: Establish scope for implementing programmatic sound engine, local database history tracker, bouncy layout animations, and boot-up visual loader.

steps.title: Synchronize Project Architecture
steps.description: Establish build configurations inside Gradle to ensure maximum compatibility with Android 14 (API 34) and Java 17 toolchains.

steps.title: Verify Application Manifest Settings
steps.description: Ensure package mapping, launcher orientation locks, and system theme parameters match strictly within the Android manifest layout.

steps.title: Update Keypad Custom Drawables
steps.description: Validate background color resources and selectors for clear active feedback across the functional numeric grid.

steps.title: Redesign UI Layout with Overlays
steps.description: Revise activity_main.xml to construct a multi-layer layout using FrameLayout, integrating main computation keyboard, sliding history view, and startup loader.

steps.title: Implement Digital Sound Synthesizer Engine
steps.description: Develop a Java 8 compliant static tone synthesizer utilizing ToneGenerator to play clean physical retro clicks and melody cues.

steps.title: Build Bouncy Tactile Button Animations
steps.description: Create a programmatic scale translation animation helper to yield a satisfying physical bounce feel upon tapping the calculation inputs.

steps.title: Implement Local History Database
steps.description: Integrate persistent local database logging via SharedPreferences to store successful calculations up to a maximum threshold of 50 items.

steps.title: Design Animated Loader Overlay
steps.description: Integrate startup timing loops with infinite title scale pulse animations to handle beautiful fading entries on app boot.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic History Populate Layout
steps.description: Author code to dynamically inject history list item views with custom selectors, allowing users to scroll and interact with old calculations.

steps.title: Connect History Item Retrieval Engine
steps.description: Enable full text recall that inputs any calculation selected directly from history items back into the active expression buffers.

steps.title: Integrate Curtained Sliding Animations
steps.description: Construct TranslateAnimation frameworks in Java to slide the calculator history curtain in and out seamlessly.

steps.title: Map Layout Components and Triggers
steps.description: Link physical layouts to click listeners, binding haptic bounce triggers, synthesizer alerts, calculations preview, and window switches.

steps.title: Audit Mathematical Expression Evaluator
steps.description: Ensure evaluation parser recursive descent checks handle unary signs, percentages, and zero divisions accurately.

steps.title: Validate Manifest Namespace Integrities
steps.description: Double check all xmlns schemas, relative class designations, and launcher directives to ensure trouble-free builds.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Run the automated Gradle compiler to package resources, parse layout components, verify syntax, and generate the signed debug APK.
